thread:
claire: FYI I opened a PR to reconcile the Dedicated provisioning quickstart with the current API surface. A few different gaps across YAML, CLI, and the SDK snippets. Not a full review request, just correctness for the examples.

omar: Link?

claire: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/5155. Summary: examples still use camelCase fields, autoscale sample references `cooldown` path (deprecated), terraform snippet uses old provider attr `reservedPool` and python code calls `provision_capacity`.

ben_docs: I can take the terraform + YAML bits. Want to standardize on snake_case everywhere and add a short migration callout. Also think we should keep the quickstart small - one canonical YAML sample and short inline notes.

rachel: I'll do the python + TS SDK snippets - I'll switch the method names to `create_capacity` and `create_dedicated_capacity` as appropriate. Also will add a one-line comment about the async polling helpers in the SDK.

claire: docs-bot can you regen the snippets once rachel pushes?

docs-bot: snippet-gen: regenerated Python, TypeScript, YAML, and Terraform examples for resource `dedicated_capacity` at commit e9a4b7. Preview: https://internal/snips/5155 (internal).

omar: For the autoscale example I sketched a compact behaviour table and a small YAML. Putting it here: 

```yaml
reserved_pool: team-data-pool
autoscale:
  policy: cpu
  threshold: 0.7
  cooldown_seconds: 240
  burst_allowed: true
labels:
  preemptible: "false"
```

This uses `cooldown_seconds` and `burst_allowed` to mirror runtime config.

ben_docs: Nice. Two docs notes: 1) add a tiny "During cooldown" line (no scale-ups until cooldown expires). 2) Add a short example showing `preemptible: "true"` and call out eviction semantics.

tom: Legal asked that we don't suggest the quickstart guarantees multi-shard availability. Can we add a footnote: "SLA metrics are reported per reserved-pool-shard; aggregate availability can vary (see SLA matrix)" and link to the SLA page?

claire: Yes — rachel, drop that footnote text into the SLA section. Also include a short example label for cost-sensitive setups: `labels:\n  preemptible: "true"\n  cost_tier: "spot"` and a one-line tradeoff: cheaper but evictable.

rachel: Will do. Also adding a small migration callout at top: "If you automated provisioning: reserved_pool replaced reservedPool; create_capacity replaces provision_capacity; CLI flags: `create-capacity` replaces `provision`." Short and to the point.

ben_docs: I'm going to update the terraform snippet to use provider v2 attrs and include a comment linking to the migration note. Keeping the TF snippet minimal.

claire: Plan: ben -> terraform + YAML consolidation; rachel -> SDK + footnote + migration callout; omar -> autoscale table blurb; tom -> quick sanity check on wording for legal. I'll bundle into one PR update and tag eng-platform + docs reviewers. Target merge: tomorrow EOD.

rachel: Pushed snippet updates to branch `docs/dedicated-examples-refresh` and dropped regenerated snippets link in the PR body. PR is https://github.com/redwood/docs/pulls/5155.

claire: Thanks all. Small nit: prefer the phrase "tenant unit" in the migration note instead of "tenant" to avoid ambiguity. If no objections I'll squash & merge after approvals. :thumbsup:
